profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Senior FrontEnd Developer
profile.summary: João Vitor Romero da Cruz is a Senior Engineer with 6+ years of experience in application development. His core focus is Web development with Angular v2 to v22, Javascript/Typescript, and HTML/CSS and Node.js. He also has experience working with React, AngularJS, Python, .NET. João has successfully worked with a range of clients, as part of  distributed teams using agile methodologies. He has experience leading estimations, a strong sense of teamwork and is passionate about new technologies, willing to face new challenges and find effective solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a diverse, multicultural team distributed globally.

- Designed and developed Angular applications for the UXMP team, API Developer Portal and more recently on MCP Marketplace, focusing on scalable, maintainable front-end architecture.

- Built and integrated multiple Micro Frontends using Angular Elements and Module Federation, enabling modular development and independent deployment of features.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular (Framework) · CSS · HTML5 · JavaScript · TypeScript · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and architectured components for the Ignition Design System using React and Storybook
- Developed pages for Salty project using React

positions.title: Front-end developer
positions.description:
My main job at James Delivery was the development, new features and maintenance of the new system for monitoring real time orders. Since the conception of the project to development in Angular 10+ and GraphQL with Apollo.
Also worked in several other projects, which included micro-frontends, to legacy projects.

- Led front-end development and developed new tools and modules using Angular 2+
- Designed, developed and implemented a new product  for real time tracking of orders
- Performed maintenance and enhancements
- Performed code reviews
- Performed deployment along with the Devops team
- Gave training and assistance to new junior developers
- Delivery included: HTML, CSS, Javascript, Angular 2+, GraphQL,Apollo

positions.title: Front-end Developer
positions.description:
Work developing web applications for educational business using Angular 7+ and Apache Cordova.

- Managed front-end activities 
- Architected and developed the frontend for Luminos’ main product, which is a hybrid application (Web, - Android and iOS) used in schools and other educational companies
- Delivery included: Angular 2+, Cordova, Android, iOS, NodeJS, and Firebase

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description: Work developing front-end systems using Angular 2+, HTML, CSS, Javascript, Ionic and Apache Cordova, Android and iOS for usage inside and outside the University.

positions.description: Internship on development, mostly doing refactors and developing in AngularJS, CSS, HTML, Javascript, and Android (Java).

projects.title: Luminos IBREP
projects.description:
Aplicativo Luminos para a instituição de ensino IBREP.

O novo aplicativo IBREP ONE te deixa mais perto da instituição e seus cursos!

Navegue em todas as funções do app:

FEED
Veja conteúdo rapidamente com um feed de notícias e novidades!

FINANÇAS
Aqui você pode conferir seus status financeiro com a instituição, além de checar cobranças em aberto e consultar seu contrato financeiro.

CONTATOS
Encontre os principais meios de comunicação da instituição ou entre em contato diretamente na área de contatos.

MATERIAIS
Nessa área você tem acesso a documentos e artigos colocados pela própria instituição.

ALUNO
Na área do aluno é possível conferir suas notas e desempenho num período de avaliação, além de fornecer um acesso rápido ao AVA da instituição.

AGENDA
Uma agenda organizada com os principais eventos listados.

projects.title: GuideOn Positivo
projects.description:
Sistema de avaliação de docentes do Grupo Positivo.
* Grave as aulas
* Envie para o sistema
* Faça sua auto-avaliação
* Aguarde a avaliação de um avaliador oficial
* Receba feedback dos seus pontos fortes e fracos
Melhore seu rendimento em sala de aula
